newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Postabank seeks police probe of run.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Postabank seeks police probe of run.

text.p: Hungary's Postabank, hit by panic withdrawals of some 21 billion forints over the weekend, said on Monday it will complain to police about deliberate rumour-spreading.
"Several facts point to a deliberately started rumour," Robert Muranyi, Postabank's marketing director, told Reuters.
He said panic withdrawals started on Thursday afternoon at the Vac (north Hungary) central post office and spread to other regions of the country, including the capital, Budapest.
He also said the bank, Hungary's second largest, had information that unknown people deliberately spread rumours among customers queueing up outside Postabank branches.
"Persons claiming to be Postabank employees spread rumours in the queues," Muranyi said.
Bank regulators have said Postabank has assets of some 70 billion forints ($400 million) which could be liquidated quickly to cover the withdrawals.
